text: The Agnes Macphail Award was established by the Borough of East York. It continues today as an annual event to recognize an outstanding volunteer who lives within the boundaries of the former borough. The Agnes Macphail Selection Committee met, as established in the selection process, on Monday, February 11, 2019 to examine the nominations received and to select this year's award recipient. The committee voted to nominate Karen Fraser as the 2019 Agnes Macphail Award recipient. The award will be presented on March 24, 2019 which is the anniversary of Agnes Macphail's birth.
City Council on February 26, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve Karen Fraser as the recipient of the 2019 Agnes Macphail Award.
